messages:
maria: Noticed p50 regressions for tiny requests after yesterday's packing change. p50 +15ms on seq<=32. Anyone on traces?

raj: Traces show extra scan in soft-lease handoff; OK normally but under batch occupancy it adds ~8-12ms.

devon: That scan allows cross-tenant micro-coalesce; wins tokens but hurts the micro fastpath.

sasha: Tradeoff summary: isolation (dedicated tiny lane) vs packing (micro-coalesce) vs API complexity (deadline hints / prefer_fastpath).

maria: Proposal: run gated experiment matrix: occupancy-gate, kv-hit-gate, and dedicated tiny-lane variant. Collect p50/p95/p99 + kv_cache_hit_rate + per-tenant fastpath_quota.

lee: Implementation notes: add flags: micro_coalesce.gate = { type: "occupancy", threshold: N } and admission API tryAcquire(key, deadline_ms).

raj: Telemetry to add: runtime.batcher.softlease.scan_ms, runtime.batcher.fastpath.fallback_count, runtime.queue.tiny.wait_ms, runtime.queue.kv_cache_hit_rate.

devon: Short-term mitigation: short-circuit scan for requests matching tiny heuristic (max_seq:32, max_tokens:128) and log marker softlease_shortcircuit=true.

maria: Ship short-circuit as hotfix to canary pools, then run 24h A/B: 10% occupancy-gate, 10% kv-hit-gate, control baseline elsewhere.

deploy-bot: deploy: Canary rollout started for pool-canary-5 at 02:04 UTC.

raj: Also add per-tenant fastpath quota (tokens/min) so prefer_fastpath can't be abused; metric fastpath_quota_utilization.

sasha: I'll draft a short RFC fragment outlining tradeoffs and the experiment plan. Keep the doc focused: measurable success criteria and rollback gates.

maria: Thanks. Action items: raj -> telemetry + quota; devon -> short-circuit code + log marker; lee -> canary configs; sasha -> RFC fragment. Recheck tomorrow with 24h data.
